title: AssessmentItem
description: YAML front matter of course/assessments/items/UNN-INN.md. One quiz/homework/exam question. Never called just 'question' (D-012).

item_class.description: Homework module (HW-D02): the pedagogical class from course/assessments/item-classes.yaml, e.g. 'DIY', 'Practicing', 'Coding', 'Research'. Independent of `format`. Optional; expected on homework items.

guiding_questions.description: What this item actually tests. Required — an item that maps to no guiding question is testing something students were never asked to learn.

usage.description: Where this item may be used. Items marked 'exam' are subject to the confidentiality decision still open in Q-002.

stem.description: The question as presented to the student.

choices.description: Required for multiple-choice / multiple-select. Every distractor needs a rationale — a distractor nobody can justify is noise.

rationale.description: Why a student would pick this. For distractors: the specific misconception it detects.

model_answer.description: Model answer, for open/numeric/code formats. Renamed from `answer` (D-031g; carried out by the homework module, HW-D08). An autograded code item's runnable reference is `expected_solution`.

rubric.description: Required in practice for open-format items.

tolerance.description: Homework module. For `numeric`: absolute tolerance around `model_answer`. Use this or `tolerance_pct`, not both.

tolerance_pct.description: Homework module. For `numeric`: tolerance as a percent of `model_answer`.

measurement_units.description: Homework module (HW-D14). For `numeric`: the units the answer is measured in (e.g. ms, bytes), checked separately from the number. Not `units`, which elsewhere means course units.

starter_code.description: Homework module. For Coding-class items: the skeleton the student edits.

expected_solution.description: Homework module. For `format: code`: the runnable reference the autograder executes against `tests`.

tests.description: Homework module. For `format: code`: deterministic test cases (no wall-clock, randomness or network).

source_ref.description: Homework module. For an adapted item: the id of the original item, which is never modified.

evaluation_strategy.description: Homework module (HW-D07). Per-item override of the item class's evaluation strategy, used by item-solver.

status.description: Homework module (HW-Q03). `draft` marks a pipeline-written file awaiting Gate 2 approval; absent means shipped. Documentary only: the validator does not yet treat drafts differently.
